profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ C3 AI
profile.summary:
I am a tech enthusiast with entrepreneurial spirit. I have industry experience building software, web applications (React, Redux, TypeScript, SASS, Node), and GenAI solutions. 

As an engineer, my mission is to make the world a fairer and more sustainable place, through technology and optimization. If you have a social impact idea, do not hesitate to contact me!

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Implemented redesign of LMS (platform used by more than 70,000 students worldwide) with React. Migrated the project to TypeScript.

Implemented frontend of global payments gateway, compatible with more than 30 payment providers, using React Hooks and Server-side rendering techniques (NextJS).

Created React components library with Storybook and tested it with react-testing-library, leading to 50% faster development times across projects through component reutilization.

positions.title: React Developer Intern
positions.description:
Led development of an open-source e-learning authoring tool using Yarn+Webpack+Babel+React+Redux.

Optimized web pack architecture leading to 25% faster loading speeds by reducing bundle package

Designed and developed a template system for resources, following the design principle WYSIWYG, and a template-creation system for designers, SASS-compatible.

Mentored and guided 3 new interns in the research group

positions.title: Alexa Developer
positions.description: Co-designed and implemented Twitter chatbot and Alexa skill for handling urbanism inquiries as an R+D project for Madrid City Hall. Used AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SES, CloudWatch, API Gateway) for backend and DialogFlow and Alexa Developer Console for the frontend. Success of the project led to further investment in voice technologies by the City Hall (Cibeles+).

positions.title: Host
positions.description: ImpactHub sponsored my team project (Civis) and helped design a business model for social impact with the assistance of Cecilia Serravalle

positions.title: Talentum ST Intern at Wayra
positions.description: Telefonica provided funding and assistance in the technical development of my personal project (Civis), being coached by Pablo Portero

honors.title: Beca de Excelencia de la Comunidad de Madrid

honors.title: TelecoEmprende: Primer Premio
honors.description: Obtuvimos el primer premio en el concurso de emprendimiento TelecoEmprende, con el proyecto ETSITChallenge, que propone una plataforma de retos que conecta a los estudiantes con los grupos de investigación de la Escuela

volunteerExperiences.description: Ganador con el proyecto "Lost In Madrid" una plataforma para refugiados y migrantes donde pueden encontrar los servicios necesarios para su día a dia

projects.title: ETSITChallenge
projects.description: ETSITChallenge propone una plataforma colaborativa entre los alumnos y los Grupos de Investigación de la ETSIT. Busca fomentar la motivación y dar a conocer los problemas reales a los que se enfrenta un ingeniero en su día a día. El concepto fue presentado en el concurso telecoEmprende 2018, donde recibió el primer premio.

projects.title: Civis
projects.description: Mobile app that promotes citizen involvement using gamification. Business model designed in courses sponsored by BBVA and in collaboration with Madrid City Hall, Impact Hub Madrid, UnLtd Spain and Medialab Madrid.
